title: eval-harness: per-prompt quality CI gate + metrics exporter integration
author: Maya Singh
description:
Context: Our per-prompt regression checks have historically run as a bulk threshold over aggregated prompt sets, which masks localized quality regressions on high-priority prompts. This PR adds a per-prompt quality CI gate (configurable thresholds) and integrates a lightweight metrics exporter so teams can track per-prompt evaluation metrics in Prometheus/StatsD.

Motivation: reduce noisy rollbacks by surfacing prompt-level regressions early and provide actionable metrics for troubleshooting.

Changes included:
- New per_prompt_gate module that loads prompt set metadata and evaluates delta against baseline metrics (accuracy/ROUGE/embedding-sim) with configurable thresholds per prompt priority.
- CI hook that runs per-prompt checks in parallel and emits a structured report consumed by our existing eval-harness CI step.
- Metrics exporter (eval_harness.metrics.exporter) that exposes per-prompt counts, fail_reason labels, and rolling delta histograms (Prometheus client).
- Console docs update: how to configure per-prompt thresholds and interpret CI artifacts.

Checklist:
- [x] Add per-prompt gate implementation
- [x] Wire gate into CI hook (github actions)
- [x] Add metrics exporter and integration tests

Local testing: ran eval-harness unit and integration suites (python -m pytest tests/eval_harness/*) and a canary run against staging prompt sets (staging-evals namespace) to validate gating behavior.

- Daniel Kim: "One concern: the exporter labels cardinality could explode if prompt ids are unbounded." — Author: "We cap label cardinality by exposing prompt_priority label (high/med/low) and only emitting detailed labels for whitelisted prompt sets; added config to control label granularity."
- Liam O'Connor: "CI runtime increased on initial run; any otimizations?" — Author: "Implemented parallel worker pool and early-bail on stable prompts; reduced median runtime from ~12m to ~3.5m in staging runs; included numbers in PR description."
- Asha Patel (approval): "Approved after small nits addressed."

Rollout notes and release notes:
- This change enables per-prompt quality gating in CI. Teams must opt in by adding a per_prompt_gate section to their eval config; default behavior remains aggregate gating.
- Metrics exporter is opt-in and can be toggled via eval_harness.metrics.export.enabled in config.

Release notes (short): "Add per-prompt quality CI gate and metrics exporter for finer-grained regression detection; opt-in via eval-harness config."
